review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — closeTask writes risk from task.card.risk and prompt_tokens from the largest '~N prompt tokens' figure on build-started timeline lines, and omits prompt_tokens when no line has one. history-cost.test.ts covers both cases end to end through closeTask.
- A2: met — renderCost lists low-risk rows with cost_usd > 1 by id, cost and prompt_tokens, and prints a 'none:' line when there are none. metrics-cost.test.ts covers both through runMetrics and directly.
- A3: met — costFlags requires risk === 'low', so rows without risk are never flagged. Tested with T-0009 at $5 and T-0004 at $9.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- history.jsonl is read twice on the full metrics path `packages/cli/src/commands/metrics.ts:122` — Read history once and derive both the count and the cost rows from that single read, or reuse rows where loadHistory's result is only counted.
- 'n/a prompt tokens' reads awkwardly `packages/cli/src/commands/metrics.ts:93` — Render 'prompt size unknown' when prompt_tokens is undefined, and update the new test to match.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `packages/action/dist/SOURCE_SHA256` (generated), `packages/action/dist/index.js` (generated)._

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: history.jsonl is read twice on the full metrics path
suggestions.detail: runMetrics now calls historyRows(root) for the cost section, and later calls loadHistory(root) for the history count. Both read the same file. Two reads can see different contents if a close lands between them, and the history logic is split across two call sites.
suggestions.repro: Run `rivetari metrics` without --findings. Both historyRows and loadHistory read .rivetari/history.jsonl.
suggestions.fix: Read history once and derive both the count and the cost rows from that single read, or reuse rows where loadHistory's result is only counted.

suggestions.title: 'n/a prompt tokens' reads awkwardly
suggestions.detail: When a flagged row has no prompt_tokens, the line ends with 'n/a prompt tokens'. Something like 'prompt size unknown' would read more plainly.
suggestions.repro: Run renderCost([row('T-0001', 1.01, { risk: 'low' })]). The output ends with 'n/a prompt tokens'.
suggestions.fix: Render 'prompt size unknown' when prompt_tokens is undefined, and update the new test to match.

renderCost lists low-risk rows with cost_usd > 1 by id, cost and prompt_tokens, and prints a 'none:' line when there are none. metrics-cost.test.ts covers both through runMetrics and directly.
costFlags requires risk === 'low', so rows without risk are never flagged. Tested with T-0009 at $5 and T-0004 at $9.
